name: Kalahari documentary
description: Documentary photography of hunter-gatherer life in the Kalahari: weathered faces in close portrait, adults in leather garments and bead ornaments, hunters with bows walking in single file through dry grass, firelight gatherings, red sand and thorn trees; warm, close and dignified.
light: low golden-hour sun from the side, warm skin tones, long shadows
night firelight on faces, deep darkness around
hard midday light, pale grass and a deep blue sky
soft dusk, a sunset glow behind silhouettes
composition: a tight portrait, one face filling the frame, eyes to the camera
a line of hunters walking away through tall grass
a small group around a fire, hands and faces close
one figure small against the wide flat desert
camera_or_medium: documentary photography, 35mm or 85mm lens, natural light, shallow depth of field, fine film grain
texture_detail: deep skin texture and wrinkles, leather and ostrich-eggshell beads, red sand dust, dry golden grass, sharp eyes and soft background
subjects: an elder with a deeply lined face, looking into the camera at golden hour
three hunters with bows walking in single file through tall grass
a group of adults laughing around a night fire
a woman making an ostrich-eggshell bead necklace in the shade
